title: Polynomial area growth for special Kähler metrics
summary: Let $g=w|dz|^2$ be an affine special Kähler metric on a punctured disc and let $Ξ=q(z)\,dz^3$ be its associated holomorphic cubic differential. We prove that if the $g$-area of concentric punctured neighbourhoods grows at most polynomially, then $q$ is meromorphic at the puncture. More precisely, an area bound of order $\eps^{-N}$ forces every pole of $q$ to have order strictly less than $N+3$.
